description: Get the staking status of US spot crypto ETFs: active, allowed_not_started, pending_amendment, no, not_stakeable (proof-of-work assets and XRP) or unknown, from SEC filings. For staking funds: cap and share of assets staked, the staking yield as disclosed by the issuer with its date, providers, whether rewards are kept in the fund or paid in cash, the last cash payout per share, and `coinsPerShare` — the annualised growth of coins behind each share from daily issuer snapshots (shown only where the series is clean). Per asset: funds staking and the estimated coins staked.

asset.description: Optional asset filter: btc, eth, sol, xrp, hyp, doge, link, avax, hbar, ltc, bnb, dot, sui, near, trx, zec

name: get_staking
title: Staking Inside Crypto ETFs
